name: Business Registration
description: Register a new Estonian limited liability company (OÜ). Adult applicants submitting at least the legal minimum share capital (€2500) are auto-approved by DMN and notified by email; everyone else routes to a civil-servant review queue. The send-back loop lets the reviewer return the case to the applicant with a reason.

variables.title: businessRegistration start-time variables
variables.description: Variables collected from the applicant at start time. The engine sets `initiator` from the authenticated user automatically; never include it in start_process input.

companyName.description: Trade name of the company. Must end in 'OÜ' (private limited company) — the React form appends it on blur if missing, but the MCP-driven agent should ask before submitting names without the suffix.

boardMembers.description: Board members of the new OÜ. At least one is required.

personalCode.description: Estonian 11-digit personal identification code (isikukood). Checksum not validated in POC.

shareCapital.description: Share capital in EUR. Minimum 2500 by historical Estonian Commercial Code; the React form, DMN, and Ajv all enforce this floor.

applicantFirstName.description: Applicant's first name. The MCP agent should call query_user_history('firstName') before asking — autofill when available.

applicantLastName.description: Applicant's last name. Autofill pattern same as applicantFirstName.

applicantAge.description: Applicant's age in years. Drives the auto-approval DMN (minors always need human review). Autofill via query_user_history('age').

userTasks.name: Submit business details
userTasks.description: The applicant confirms (or corrects) their business registration details. Same field set as start_process input — when start_process pre-fills them, completing this task with the identical values just advances the process. On send-back resubmit the applicant sees the previous reviewer's reason as a banner.

sendBackReason.description: Always empty on submit — the form clears the previous reason on resubmit so a future cycle starts clean.

userTasks.name: Review business registration
userTasks.description: The civil servant accepts the registration or sends it back to the applicant with a reason. If sent back, the process loops to the applicant's business-details task and the reason is shown as a banner.

decision.description: approve = end the process as approved. sendback = email the applicant with the reason and loop back to the business-details task.

sendBackReason.description: Required when decision = sendback. The applicant sees this above the business-details form on re-entry.
